source_pdf: 312 Affidavits by Indians who accepted land patents under protest 1928 [3 of 3].pdf

extraction.Name: Bessie Martin
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee at the time she accepted it, but was told that it was necessary for her to take it, and she did so
extraction.Buyer: J. W. Good, of Chadron, Nebraska, for $1000.00, cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she was back on taxes, knew that she could not meet future taxes, and thought best to take what she could get
extraction.Occupation/Income: she and her family is supported by her husband, who has poor health, but he farms her home place, and occasionally works for a neighbor, and this is the source of his income
extraction.NOTES: mentally incompetent, has poor health, having stomach trouble and rheumatism; has four minor children to support; has never received any help from the County or the Government; document number 7584; sworn November 20, 1928
